notes.title: Durak NTR Update: Hint System to Improve Your Durak Experience
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788901/4fff7035aff3a7712efee9076f426839b11d82a4.png

Hey everyone!

We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we know that some players—especially those new to Durak—wanted a little extra help getting into the game. So, we’re introducing a brand-new Hint System!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788901/a1c3d8d682cc7f8b3579276a8de36d7fbbd3a00c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788901/db620b7d735062ee7bb966e6d29997a258affeb6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788901/ecf03525f28f36adce27512c9b1d4885d4997615.png

Now, you’ll notice a lightbulb button at the bottom of the game screen. When activated, it will highlight the cards you can play, making it easier to learn the mechanics and keep the game flowing smoothly. Whether you’re just getting started or stuck in a tricky situation, this feature is here to help!

We hope this makes your experience even better. As always, we appreciate your feedback—keep it coming, and let us know what you think!

See you at the table!

notes.title: 🎭 A Fresh Update for Our Netorare Visual Novel Fans! 🎭
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576590/Stories_of_Submission_eNTeR_the_cuck/

We’re thrilled to announce that our beloved visual novel, crafted for the most passionate netorare enthusiasts, has just received a significant upgrade!

✨ What’s New?

 • Revisited Texts: Enjoy an enhanced narrative experience with refined dialogue and deeper storytelling.
 • French Localization: Bonjour, mes amis! The game is now fully localized in French, bringing our captivating tale to an even wider audience.

Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to the genre, now’s the perfect time to dive into this provocative story. Experience the emotional highs and lows like never before!

Merci pour votre soutien, and enjoy the ride!

notes.title: Durak NTR Jan. 24 UI Update Patch has released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788901/b4ce211bcf1d1989b175a706739f26795dc2c5f7.png

Hey, everyone! With today's patch we are implementing the most requested feature — skippable intro. If you are familiar with the game of Durak and don't want to read the rules for 100th time, you are free to save your time and completely skip the educational part of the game. 

We have also heard your feedback about the amount of unlockable content in the game and are already preparing some spicy additional content to make your experience extra enticing.

Sincerely yours as always,
Zee & Swimming

notes.title: Durak NTR Jan. 15 Hotfix Patch has released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788901/b4ce211bcf1d1989b175a706739f26795dc2c5f7.png

Hey, everyone! First off, we would like to thank our community and new players who played Durak NTR in the first days after release. We really enjoyed reading through all of your reviews and opinions. Your feedback is the most valuable thing you give us and with your help we hope to improve constantly. With the first patch we want to address two issues: the fixed pace of the game and the typing sound that some find annoying.

We've changed the gameflow to resemble the standard visual novel style. Texts will no longer auto-play without pressing any key and the text speed has been increased dramatically. As for the typing sound, we personally find it rather calming (especially when someone stealing your girlfriend nearby!), but we understand that others might not like it. So we've changed the volume and made it less aggressive. If you don't like it at all, you can completely switch off the typing sound by pressing ESC during the scenes and clicking on the appropriate button.

We are listening to your feedback and trying to make your gaming experience more pleasurable. We'll be looking forward to more of your detailed reviews or, if you are a shy one, send us a letter at sup.femdomwaifu@gmail.com

Sincerly yours,
Zee & Swimming
